objectives: 學習軟體定義無線電通訊技術相關之原理與實務。
content:
週次	內容	備註
1	Introduction of Software Defined Radio
2	Practical Software Defined Radio Platform: RF/Digital Frontend
3      FPGA Design with Vivado and Verilog-I
4	FPGA Design with Vivado and Verilog-II

6	Baseband Signal Processing for Software Defined Radio: Single-Carrier Modulation

9	Baseband Signal Processing for Software Defined Radio: Single-Carrier Demodulation
10	FPGA Implementation of Baseband Signal Processing: Single-Carrier Demodulation
11	Baseband Signal Processing for Software Defined Radio: OFDM Transmitter
12	FPGA Implementation of Baseband Signal Processing: OFDM Transmitter
13	Baseband Signal Processing for Software Defined Radio: OFDM Receiver
14	FPGA Implementation of Baseband Signal Processing: OFDM Receiver-I
15    FPGA Implementation of Baseband Signal Processing: OFDM Receiver-II
16	Final Exam.
